Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Motor of 
 High Pressure Pump
 A0 83-6T
 Russia
Introduction

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must performed 
on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The technical specification of the motor: 
Rated power 40 kw, Δ/Y 220 / 380 v

The first draft initiated and reviewed by eng. Nagy 
Bekheit Saleh, accepted 
by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad general director, and approved by eng. Abdel 
Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, 
Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass
Switch of the AC power supply

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass
Switch of the AC power supply

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Cleaning materials (cloth - benzene), grease for bearing

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Disconnect the leads of 
the motor and label them

Clean the motor from dust, 
clean it by benzene

After dismantling the 
motor, clean the inner parts from all foreign matters

Blow the motor with 
compressed air of 2-3 atm pressure

Inspect the guide bearing 
and replace them if necessary

Measure the resistance of 
the insulation of motor winding

Check the DC resistance 
and compare it with the reference one

After assembling the 
motor, put it into work and check its rotation
